The data catalog describes the tables available to analysts. It is distinct from
the metrics cookbook; the cookbook explains how to *derive* metrics, while the
catalog describes the *tables* those metrics are calculated from, field by field.

## Sources

Each source page covers what its tables share: where the data comes from, when
it updates, and caveats that apply to all of them.

- [Relying Parties](rp.qmd) - reference tables in the `rp` schema that identify the services using CanadaLogin and their aliases
- [IBM Verify](ibm_verify.qmd) - derived tables in the `ibm_verify` schema, pulled from the IBM Verify reporting API
- [Call Centre](call_centre.qmd) - weekly call centre data from the CanadaLogin support queue reports
- [Platform](sre.qmd) - incident response and uptime tables in the `sre` schema
- [Jira (PSOM)](jira.qmd) - daily snapshots of PSOM support tickets in the `jira` schema
- [Google Analytics](google_analytics.qmd) - tables in the `google_analytics` schema, populated from the CanadaLogin GA4 property
